 03:49 PM Nov 09, 2026 IST 
 JAMMU/LEH, Nov 9: The Ladakh Administration has increased the Dearness Allowance (DA) for Government employees continuing to draw their salaries under the 6th Pay Commission from 262 per cent to 269 per cent of basic pay.
